[serious] Ten men said the same thing: "We have seen the Lord."

[serious][deliberate] But Thomas answered them: <speaker name="thomas">"Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe."</speaker>

[reflective] Eight days he stayed with them anyway — the men he wouldn't believe.

[awe][quietly] Then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, <speaker name="jesus">"Peace be unto you."</speaker>

[deliberate][emphasized] He turned straight to Thomas: <speaker name="jesus">"Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing."</speaker>

[awe][emphasized] Thomas didn't touch a thing. He only said, <speaker name="thomas">"My Lord and my God."</speaker>

[reflective] And Jesus answered him — answered you too: <speaker name="jesus">"Because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed."</speaker>
